name: Prefix And Suffix Count
statement:
Given a string s, Your task is, for any prefix of string s which matches a suffix of string s, print the number of times it occurs in string s as a substring.
Expected Complexity: O(n)
inputFormat: The first line contains string s.
outputFormat: In the first line, print integer k (0<=k<=|s|) - the number of prefixes that match a suffix of string s. Next print k lines, in each line print two integers li ci. Numbers li ci mean that the prefix of the length li matches the suffix of length li and occurs in string s as a substring ci times. Print pairs li ci in the order of increasing li.
